# neuron v0.1.5 — light, layered

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). The installer and portable ZIP include the tray app and CLI. Binaries are unsigned. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `SOURCE.txt` records the source commit and build method.

This update gives lighting more room to play. Build a look in layers, mix the colours, reverse the motion and keep editing while the scene keeps moving. The lighting page has also had a substantial performance pass: scrolling, dragging and switching effects feel more immediate.

![Lighting studio update: screenshot crops of layer blending and colour motion, rendered in a disarmed GUI fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/worflor/neuron/v0.1.5/artifacts/promo/release-v0.1.5/diagonal-screenshot-draft.png)

## A better lighting studio

- **Layers that work together.** An ordered, scrollable stack with visibility, duplication, opacity and Normal, Screen, Add, Multiply and Cutout blending. A shortcut points to the opaque layer covering your selection. Hover an effect to insert it above or below the selected layer.
- **Colour without the guesswork.** Eight gradient presets, including a soap-film Bubble ramp, and suggested effect/colour pairings on catalogue tiles. Established palettes keep recognizable names, and the effect name in the inspector wears its applied palette. Compact colour mixing offers Direct, Via hue and Balanced interpolation.
- **A tighter inspector.** Clearer colour-motion choices with reverse, aligned effect controls and a compact frame timeline with timing, curves and playback. Four-way effect directions get their own reverse shortcut.
- **A scene that keeps running.** Compatible edits retain layer state; effect changes dissolve into the new moving scene. Repeated edits continue from the current picture. The live preview reads the generated base output, and clearing the final layer saves an explicitly black scene.
- **Less waiting, fewer seams.** Preview rendering and saved-effect file operations move off the UI thread, offscreen catalogue previews sleep, and short key events survive skipped presentations. High-precision animation timing and centralized palette boundaries remove unintended jumps; Comet light painting lasts longer, Ripple retains rapid typing bursts, heat extinguishes cleanly and the breathing cycle joins smoothly.

## Hardware research, without becoming a developer

Compatibility Lab can inventory recognized and unfamiliar HID devices and prepare a checked, device-scoped evidence bundle. The included `neuron-compat` agent skill guides selection, optional consented vendor-input trials and an actionable issue draft. Inventory sends no vendor commands and makes no claim that an unfamiliar device is supported. Export sanitization keeps private device paths and unique identifiers out of the shareable bundle; nothing is submitted automatically.

## Before you install

Use the installer for a normal install, or unpack the portable ZIP into a writable folder and run `neuron-app.exe`. Existing nonempty lighting scenes retain full layer opacity; older empty/FPS-only records remain unmanaged.

This remains the Windows beta. The owner exercised the editor on the Windows development machine with a BlackWidow Chroma V2 and reported smoother interaction. The new physical LED dissolves and host/game coexistence have not been visually verified on hardware. Tests use mocked transport and never arm input. Linux has no release package; macOS has no backend.

[Verification and remaining limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.5/docs/STATUS.md).
